title: Weapon damage
description: +15% weapon or spell damage per tier.

title: Quick strikes
description: Reduce attack interval by 10% of its starting value per tier.

title: Second wind
description: +25 maximum health and heal 25.

title: Fleet feet
description: +8% starting movement speed per tier.

title: Soul magnet
description: +25 XP collection range per tier.

title: Extra attacks
description: +1 melee strike per attack cycle.

title: Larger attack area
description: +10% cleave reach/width or spell splash radius per tier.

title: Extra target
description: +1 cleave target, arrow pierce or spell splash target.

title: Long reach
description: +10% attack distance and projectile travel per tier.

title: Iron skin
description: Reduce incoming contact damage by 1 per tier.

title: Regeneration
description: Restore 0.4 health per second per tier.

title: Lucky strike
description: +8 percentage points of critical chance per tier.

title: Devastating criticals
description: +20 percentage points of critical damage per tier.

title: Forceful blows
description: +8 knockback distance per tier.

title: Vital harvest
description: Restore 1 health per defeated enemy per tier.

title: Generous foes
description: +3 percentage points of healing-drop chance per tier.

title: Fast learner
description: +10% XP earned per tier.

title: Additional minion
description: Summon one additional allied minion.

title: Empowered minions
description: +5 minion damage per tier.

title: Restless minions
description: Reduce minion attack interval by 8% of its starting value per tier.

title: Warrior: bleeding edge
description: Weapon hits inflict 2 damage/second for 3 seconds per tier.

title: Warrior: retaliation
description: Taking damage deals 3 damage per tier to nearby foes.

title: Rogue: poisoned arrows
description: Arrow hits inflict 2.5 damage/second for 3 seconds per tier.

title: Rogue: swift arrows
description: +15% starting arrow speed per tier.

title: Sorcerer: lingering flames
description: Spell hits burn for 3 damage/second for 3 seconds per tier.

title: Sorcerer: raging blasts
description: +10 percentage points of firebolt splash damage per tier.

title: Lasting power
description: +20% timed boost duration per tier. Extends active boosts too.

title: Pierce
description: +1 enemy pierced per projectile. Hits enemies behind the first target.

title: Multi-shot
description: +1 projectile per attack, up to 5 projectiles.
